zone_plans.why_es: Después de Maíz amarillo duro, considera Frijol castilla / caupí para alternar familias de cultivos. El mes propuesto utiliza el calendario regional de Lima como referencia.
zone_plans.why_en: After Yellow hard maize, consider Cowpea to alternate crop families. The planting month uses the regional Lima calendar as a reference.
how_es: Antes de noviembre de 2026, comprueba agua disponible, drenaje y estado del suelo de esta zona.
Selecciona una variedad de Frijol castilla / caupí adecuada a la zona con asesoría agraria local.
Prepara las camas o surcos según suelo y variedad; ajusta semilla, profundidad y espaciamiento a la ficha técnica.
Organiza el riego y el seguimiento de plagas por etapas de desarrollo, verificando el turno real de agua.
how_en: Before November 2026, check available irrigation water, drainage, and soil conditions.
Choose a locally adapted Cowpea variety with agricultural guidance.
Prepare rows or beds for the soil and variety; confirm seed, depth and spacing in a crop guide.
Schedule irrigation and pest monitoring for growth stages, checking your actual water allocation.

spatial_plan.disclaimer_en: Reference plan based on your crop records and FAO sources. Verify water supply, soil, varieties and dates before planting. The small seasonal NASA HLS model (proof of concept) only applies to the Barranca study field.

compare.recommendation_reason_es: Los cultivos podrían necesitar cerca del 70 % menos de agua en meses secos. El tiempo sin cultivos se mantiene.
compare.recommendation_reason_en: Crops may need about 70% less water in dry months. Time without crops stays the same.
compare.recommendation_method: Relative crop-water, crop coverage and family-repeat scores; plus verified NASA HLS learned seasonal bare-risk exposure; scarce-water and +25% safety guards. No measured irrigation, harvest-yield or economic predictions.

method.water: Σ Kc(day) × ET0(month) over 730 days (FAO-56 single Kc; Kc from the team catalogue; ET0 FAO-56 Penman-Monteith from NASA POWER climatology). Bare-soil evaporation is not counted.
method.sowing_rules: S1 Water: yellow maize sown only Nov-Feb. S2 Soil: no yellow maize sown May-Jul. S0 is not restricted.
method.search: Exact dynamic programming over months: sowing only in DRA Lima sowing months, crop cycles from the catalogue, no crop repeated back-to-back, keeps the farmer's income crop; weights from the farmer's priorities. Perennial alfalfa is not proposed automatically.
method.heat: A crop is flagged when most of its heat-sensitive window (from the catalogue label) falls in the zone's 3 warmest POWER months.

compare.disclaimer_es: Son ideas para conversar, no órdenes. Revísalas con un técnico de la Agencia Agraria o de tu Junta de Usuarios antes de decidir.

seasonal_explanations: Los meses con mayor probabilidad aprendida de vegetación baja se usan para comparar cobertura entre propuestas.
El modelo fue entrenado para reconocer baja cobertura observada, no para identificar especies ni predecir cosechas.
model_limitations: 44 valid monthly observations out of 71, with persistent winter cloud gaps
labels are derived from NDVI threshold 0.2, not verified crop identity
11-month forward holdout; one parcel cannot validate generalization
year trend held at 2026 for future scenario estimates; do not interpret as a forecast of the farmer's crop
no guarantee of soil improvement, irrigation savings or harvest profit
